propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and depends on field values for drift classification, but will silently degrade classification when prev_snapshot is narrowed to a key-set with empty dict values

When prev_snapshot is narrowed to {jira_key: {}}, field-based membership checks still work but every field value-dependent classification degrades, and this out-of-band file consumer is not caught by reconcile_once tests

Against key-set prev fixtures, bridge_fsck must report drift classification as indeterminate rather than inferring from empty dicts for cases that require field values, while preserving membership-only classification for active-bound and missing-local cases
bridge_fsck must maintain byte-identical behavior against full-payload prev_snapshot and unchanged exit codes and JSON envelope shape across both key-set and full-payload fixtures
